answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the cedar queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The yarrow index is deterministic from ledger replay, and thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 504 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the onyx. A 109 account operation therefore ties up 22 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
